messages:
Clare Release: Heads-up — rolling a hotfix to EU1 that fixes intermittent DB connection churn seen in the last 20m. Requesting expedited approval for an early-window deploy (2:30am UTC). Image: `gcr.io/redwood/hotfix/db-conn-fix:548a2`

Clare Release: Impact: short spike of 502s on embed/write paths, low user impact but noisy errors in our pager; change window requested to avoid daytime traffic. Plan: canary 5% for 10m -> 25% for 15m -> 100% if metrics look good.

deploy-bot: deploy request created: `DR-20260322-3287654321`
Command: `deploy start --cluster eu1 --image gcr.io/redwood/hotfix/db-conn-fix:548a2 --canary 5% --stages 5m,10m`

Mike Ops: @Clare Release thanks for the details. Please pin the image and attach rollback criteria. Ops +1 if we have clear SLO rollback triggers and a verified db migrate-free path.

Clare Release: pinned image in release notes https://internal.redwood/release/DR-20260322-3287654321 and added rollback plan:
- immediate rollback to `gcr.io/redwood/main:20260320-9d3f` if error rate >2% sustained for 5m on embed/write endpoints
- fallback: route traffic to eu2 if connection pool pressure continues

SRE Oncall: Can we get the exact metric names? I'll wire the alert to a shadow dashboard.

Emma Eng: Metrics: `http.error_rate.embed_write` and `infrastructure.db.conn_failures` — both in prometheus. Health check: `curl -sS https://eu1-health.internal/ready | jq .status` should return "ok". Add circuit-breaker threshold: if `infrastructure.db.conn_failures` > 50/min for 2m -> pause canary.

Jon Chen: Reviewed the diffs, code looks narrowly scoped. :thumbsup: Approve.

Mike Ops: +1 from ops. Confirm we have a rollback runbook and runbook owner. Who is on rotation?

Clare Release: Runbook owner: @Mike Ops, rollback steps at bottom of release page. I will be on-call for the rollout and will coordinate traffic shifts.

deploy-bot: Approval checks: 2/2 approvals (Jon Chen, Mike Ops) — proceeding with canary. Starting stage 1 (5%): `DR-20260322-3287654321` -> rolling to 12 pods. ETA ~90s.

deploy-bot: [logs] pod/db-hotfix-1 -> Ready; pod/db-hotfix-2 -> Ready; pod/db-hotfix-3 -> Ready

SRE Oncall: Watching dashboards. Initial latency and error rate stable. No spike on `http.error_rate.embed_write` after 3m.

deploy-bot: Canary stage passed (5% for 10m). Advancing to 25% for 15m.

Emma Eng: Running smoke load: `wrk -t4 -c50 -d30s https://eu1-embed.internal/test` — no errors, conn failures remain <5/min.

Mike Ops: Good. You have ops signoff to continue to full rollout if the 25% stage stays green.

deploy-bot: Rolling to 100% (final stage). Progress: 40% -> 70% -> 100%. All pods updated.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: `DR-20260322-3287654321` — status: SUCCESS.

Clare Release: Thanks all. Post-deploy checklist: monitor for 30m; if any alert hits, I'll initiate rollback. Release note: https://internal.redwood/release/DR-20260322-3287654321/notes

Jon Chen: Nice quick turnaround. :raised_hands:

SRE Oncall: I'll keep the alert threshold on a tighter window for the next 60m.

Clare Release: Closing the expedited approval thread. Will file a short postmortem if we see any regressions.

deploy-bot: Thread archived by deploy-bot.
